maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from new smart meters, AMI networks, devices and software sold to utilities, not aftermarket repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mostly utilities (energy, water, gas) funded by ratepayers; some municipal buyers, but not mainly government-paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through meters, networks and software sales; occasional acquisitions like Urbint and Locusview are not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Embedded AMI meters, networks and grid software run utility metering and billing; switching means costly replacement and operational disruption.

notes: Utility ownership mix (investor-owned versus public) is uncertain, but ratepayers are the final payers.
